setup_logger: setup a detectron2 logger with optional file output and colored terminal formatting for distributed training
log_first_n: log a message only for the first n times using caller or message as the deduplication key
log_every_n: log a message once every n calls from the same caller location
log_every_n_seconds: log a message no more than once every n seconds from the same caller location
create_small_table: create a small pipe-formatted table string from a dictionary with keys as headers and values as a single row
